text_block_list.text:
Vodka asked me to join her for some solo 
practice, so we came to the gym.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer... Having a bigger body 
makes you stronger and cooler, right?"
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
What's the matter all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, though... Just bein' huge ain't 
enough...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It won't look right unless you've got a 
burly build, just like an American 
heavyweight motorcycle.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And yet...! Without even realizing that, I 
was just...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All I ever cared about was getting bigger 
and biggeeerrr!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Listening to you makes my head 
spin. *That's* the reason you've been 
stuffing your face every single day?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —S-Scarlet! How long have you been there?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"You might as well let her work you to the 
bone right now. Otherwise, don't blame me 
if your speed drops."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Y-You don't need to tell me, I was 
already going to!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If it's come to this, I'll train until 
every single muscle in my body is 
completely shredded!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, you'd better do your best. Unless 
you want to end up as just my opening act, 
that is?

Whether it was Daiwa Scarlet lighting a 
fire under her that did the trick, Vodka 
threw herself furiously into muscle 
training and returned to her original 
figure.
